name: Game Master
source:
Age - ???

His words cannot be contradicted, his will cannot be disobeyed, and his desires cannot be refused. In this world, the Game Master is God, and everything he says goes, regardless of how crazy it is. For some reason he likes to set up lewd scenarios for Akira, which probably means that he's a huge pervert. Nobody's exactly sure what's going on in his head, and they may never know the reasons behind his actions.

[From in-game bio]
